title: 盖伦·蓝披风高阶
description: 盖伦穿完整银金甲胄立于宽阔石阶，双手扶住剑柄，大剑剑尖落地静止，蓝披风形成清楚大色块。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Garen is a broad adult Demacian knight with short brown hair, a square clean-shaven face, heavy silver armor, gold accents, and a royal-blue cape or scarf. Preserve his substantial natural adult proportions, oversized shoulder armor, fully covered torso and legs, gauntlets, and boots. His enormous straight broadsword rests tip-down on stone, held motionless by the pommel with no striking gesture.
art_direction.scene: Show him in a steadfast full-body stance before a monumental stairway, both feet planted and both hands loosely resting on the grounded sword. A hard golden light crosses one shoulder and the face, leaving a broad blue shadow. Decisive wax-crayon armor facets and a single sweeping cape plane stand against distant uncluttered towers and open sky.
art_direction.palette: royal blue, silver gray, warm gold, pale limestone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
